why: RJ-X70 (suiteui/area-selection AR-10): on a 96 x 96 portrait (a skin-toned face on grey), selects the ellipse around the face, subtracts a lasso triangle over the chin, inverts, feathers 8 px, fills the selection with the brush colour (black: no command sets it yet) and exports the PNG. The trap: Option adds instead of subtracting, the feather is ignored, or Invert selects the whole canvas. The assertion: the face centre is unchanged, the chin notch and the surround are filled, and the edge ramp from 10% to 90% filled is at least 6 px wide (PhotoAreaSelectionTests.selectShapesJobPasses).
